title: Rate allotments on a grounds round
text:
Rate allotments on a grounds round. I go round the grounds as assessor and give every allotment a one-to-five mark for how well it's worked, with a picture, so that abandoned ones get caught before they go wild.
- Marks are saved without a connection and upload once there's coverage.
- Three or higher requires three-quarters of the area to be growing something.

title: Accept or decline a plot offer
text:
Accept or decline a plot offer. I get an offer when a plot comes free and I'm next in line, and I accept or decline it within fourteen days, so that plots don't sit empty.
- The offer shows the plot size, a photo and the annual rent.
- If I don't answer in fourteen days, the offer goes to the next person.
- Declining twice moves me to the bottom of that list.

title: Split a full plot into halves
text: Split a full plot into halves. I split a full-size plot into two half plots with their own numbers as site coordinator, so that more people on the list can start growing sooner.

title: Donate a tool to the shed
text: Donate a tool to the shed. I offer a tool I no longer need to the shared shed, and the coordinator accepts it into the catalogue, so that others can borrow it.

title: Check a tool back in
text:
Check a tool back in. I check a tool back in by scanning the QR tag on it, so that the next borrower can see it's back on the hook.
- If I haven't checked in an hour after my slot ends, the coordinator gets an alert.
- Fuel level is recorded for petrol tools.

title: See my plot's water use
text:
See my plot's water use. I see how many litres my plot used each week this season, taken from its sub-meter, so that I can tell whether mulching is actually saving water.
- The chart compares my use with the site average for plots of the same size.

title: Tool donations with a wish list
text: Tool donations with a wish list. I offer a tool I no longer need to the shared shed, and the coordinator accepts it into the catalogue, so that others can borrow it. I also see a wish list of tools the shed is short of, ranked by how often people asked for them.

title: Join a watering rota and Unpaid rent reminders
text:
Join a watering rota and Unpaid rent reminders. I join a watering rota with the neighbours in my row, so that our plots get watered while any of us is away. I get reminders at seven, fourteen and twenty-eight days if my rent is unpaid, so that I sort it out before my tenancy is at risk.
- Each person picks the days they cover.
- I get a reminder the evening before my turn.
- I can swap a day with someone else on the rota.
- Each reminder has a pay-now link.

title: Check water tank levels
text:
Check water tank levels. I check how full each water tank on my site is before I walk down, so that I bring cans from home when the tanks are low.
- Levels come from float sensors and update every thirty minutes.

title: Water use with a seasonal allowance
text:
Water use with a seasonal allowance. I see how many litres my plot used each week this season, taken from its sub-meter, so that I can tell whether mulching is actually saving water. I also get a seasonal water allowance for my plot and see how much of it is left.
- The chart compares my use with the site average for plots of the same size.
- The allowance scales with plot size.

title: Post surplus produce
text:
Post surplus produce. Posts expire after three days.
- I can mark a post as gone.

title: Borrow from the seed library
text:
Borrow from the seed library. I borrow seed packets from the site seed library and return saved seed from my own crop at the end of the season, so that the library keeps itself stocked.
- Each variety shows germination notes from past borrowers.
- I can take up to five packets at a time.

title: Book a green waste skip slot
text:
Book a green waste skip slot. I book a slot to tip woody prunings in the green waste skip, so that the skip isn't overfilled before collection day.
- Each slot is 20 minutes and covers one car boot or wheelbarrow load.
- Slots close when the skip is marked three-quarters full.

title: Track my volunteer hours
text:
Track my volunteer hours. I see my volunteer hours for the year against the twelve hours every plot holder owes, so that I know if I'm short before renewal.
- Hours are added when the organiser marks attendance after a work party.

title: Suggest a work party job and Report rats at the compost
text:
Suggest a work party job and Report rats at the compost. I suggest a job for the next work party, like clearing the bramble corner, so that jobs nobody owns get done. I report rats near the compost bays, so that pest control is called.
- Other holders can upvote suggestions.
- The organiser picks from the top five when planning.
- Three reports in a week trigger an automatic call-out request.

title: Sign up for a work party
text:
Sign up for a work party. I sign up for a Saturday work party and pick a task such as hedge cutting or path weeding, so that the organiser knows how many people to expect.
- Each task has a cap on helpers.
- I can cancel up to the evening before.

title: Pay annual plot rent
text:
Pay annual plot rent. I pay my yearly plot rent by card in the app, so that I don't have to post a cheque to the council.
- Rent is due on 1 October and the app shows the amount from September.

title: Apply for a concession rate
text:
Apply for a concession rate. I apply for the half-price concession by uploading proof of pension or benefits, so that I pay what I can afford.
- The treasurer approves or rejects each application.
- Approval lasts one year and must be renewed.

title: Volunteer hours shared across a joint tenancy
text:
Volunteer hours shared across a joint tenancy. I see my volunteer hours for the year against the twelve hours every plot holder owes, so that I know if I'm short before renewal. I also pool hours with my joint tenant, so either of us can cover the other's share.
- Hours are added when the organiser marks attendance after a work party.

title: Pay a refundable plot deposit
text:
Pay a refundable plot deposit. I pay a refundable £50 deposit when my tenancy starts and get it back when I leave the plot in good order, so that clearing abandoned plots isn't paid for by everyone.
- The deposit is held separately from rent in the accounts.
- The coordinator records the exit check that releases it.

title: Renew by direct debit
text:
Renew by direct debit. I set up a direct debit so my rent renews each October without me doing anything, so that I never lose my plot over a missed payment.
- The mandate is collected on 1 October.
- I'm warned by email ten days before each collection.

title: Settle the allotment fee online
text:
Settle the allotment fee online. I clear the annual charge for my allotment online from my phone, so that I'm not mailing paper payments to the local authority.
- The charge falls due each October the first and appears from the start of September.

title: Record a plot inspection
text:
Record a plot inspection. I walk the site as inspector and score each plot on cultivation from 1 to 5 with a photo, so that neglected plots are spotted early.
- Scores work offline and sync when I'm back in signal.
- A plot needs at least 75% cultivated to score 3 or more.

title: Request the reduced fee
text:
Request the reduced fee. I send in evidence of retirement income or welfare support and ask for the 50% discount, so that the cost stays within my means.
- Each request is signed off or turned down by the committee's finance officer.
- A granted discount runs for twelve months, then I reapply.
